extName.message: MemeBox – Meme Soundboard & Voice Changer for Calls

extDesc.message: Meme soundboard for video calls: play meme lines and sounds into your mic so everyone in the call hears them.

actionTitle.message: MemeBox – send this tab's sound to your call

join_first.message: Join the call first, then press 😂

err_reload.message: MemeBox was updated – reload the call tab

muted_nobody.message: You are muted – memes are silent too. Unmute and try again.

no_lines.message: No lines yet – add some in Options

slot_empty.message: Nothing on Alt+$1 yet – pick a favourite slot in Options

ui_hidden.message: MemeBox hidden – press Alt+M to show it again

tab_on.message: 📺 Your other tab's sound is going into the call

tab_bar.message: 📺 Another tab's sound is playing into your mic

st_none.message: No call joined yet – join the call, then press 😂

st_suspended.message: Click anywhere on the page once to switch memes on

st_muted.message: You are muted – memes are silent until you unmute

fab_tip.message: Click: random meme · hold or right-click: panel · drag to move

btn_mic_test_tip.message: Plays a short ding-dong into your mic – ask someone in the call if they heard it

monitor_tip.message: The call always gets the meme through your mic. This only adds a quiet copy on your own speakers.

monitor_on.message: 🎧 You and the call both hear memes

monitor_off.message: 🔇 Only the call hears memes now

monitor_on_tip.message: You hear memes too (click to stop hearing them – the call still hears them)

monitor_off_tip.message: You don't hear memes (click to hear them too – the call hears them either way)

duck_tip.message: Memes get quieter while you are talking

panel_foot.message: Click a line to play it · 😂 random · Alt+1…9 favourites · Alt+0 stop · Alt+M hide

timers_on.message: ⏰ Timed lines are on (while a call is open): $1

empty_star.message: No favourites yet – tap ☆ on a line

pp_send.message: 🎙 Send this tab's sound to my call

pp_how1.message: Join your call in another tab (Meet, Zoom web, Teams web or Discord web).

pp_how2.message: In this tab, start the YouTube video or Instagram reel at the funny moment.

pp_how3.message: Click “Send this tab's sound” – everyone in the call hears it through your mic.

pp_how4.message: Click ⏹ when you're done, or use ⏹ in the 😂 panel.

pp_how_note.message: Nothing is downloaded or recorded – the sound is only mixed live into your mic.

pp_no_call.message: Join a call first (in another tab), then come back to the video tab and click here.

pp_this_is_call.message: This is your call tab. Open the YouTube / Instagram tab and click MemeBox there to send its sound. Use 😂 on this page for memes.

pp_sending.message: ✅ This tab's sound is going into your call.

pp_replace.message: Another tab is being sent right now. Sending this one will replace it.

pp_start_video.message: Start the video at the funny part, then:

pp_join_unmute.message: Join the call and unmute first.

pp_cant_capture.message: Chrome won't let this tab be captured: $1
